name: cdp-bridge
description: Persistent Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) bridge plugins for Claude Code (lightweight CLI edition and MCP edition).

plugins.name: cdp-bridge
plugins.description: Lightweight CLI edition: bundles the cdp-bridge browser debugging skill and a PreToolUse Bash guard blocking raw :9222 bypasses (ideal for Linux / WSL2 / macOS).

plugins.name: cdp-bridge-mcp
plugins.description: MCP + CLI edition: exposes 16 structured UTF-8 MCP browser tools over the shared cdp-bridge daemon alongside the workflow skill and Bash guard (ideal for native Windows).
